clue.text: Reversed with help near van

parts.note: to back someone is to support or help them
to can mean near, as in close to
the van is the front or vanguard of an army

explanation.surface: Someone backed up with the help of a man waiting by a van.
explanation.walkthrough: 'van' is short for vanguard, the leading part of a force, so it gives FRONT rather than a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something turned the wrong way round, rear foremost, has been reversed.

clue.text: "Throw him a bone" comes from Virginia Woolf perhaps

indicators.note: throw says the letters of him a bone are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: A famous writer is quoted urging someone to toss a dog a bone.
explanation.definitionFit: Woolf belonged to the Bloomsbury Group, an example of artistic unconventional living.

clue.text: Right about having nothing to stop macho nonsense in place of discussion

indicators.note: to stop says the group plugs a gap inside the jumbled letters
nonsense says the letters of macho are jumbled
having says the nothing letter is attached to the reversed pair
about says the right abbreviation is turned round

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A call to curb macho posturing in a forum for debate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nonsense' is the anagram signal on 'macho', and 'about' reverses the abbreviation; the 'in' before the definition is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An online forum where users exchange messages is a virtual venue for conversation.

clue.text: Extremely thorough before a sympathetic word

indicators.note: extremely takes the extreme letters, first and last, of thorough

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Being extremely thorough before offering a kind word.
explanation.definitionFit: Said twice as comfort, as in soothing a crying child, it is a word of consolation.

clue.text: One going with female for party leader is a fraud

indicators.note: for says the female letter replaces the party leader

parts.note: a piddler is one who goes, in the childish sense of urinating

indicators.note: leader takes the opening letter of party

explanation.surface: A woman stands in for the party leader, who turns out to be a cheat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One going' is a coy way of describing someone needing the toilet; swap its P for F.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindler who fiddles the accounts or cheats is a fraud.

clue.text: Unusual puzzle disappointing at first

indicators.note: at first says the disappointing word is placed at the front

parts.note: off means below par, disappointing, as in an off day
to beat someone is to puzzle them, as in 'it beats me'

explanation.surface: An odd crossword that let the solver down at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unconventional or quirky is unusual.

clue.text: Overbearing woman's word against a couple of Gambian conservationists

parts.note: a term is a word or expression

indicators.note: couple of takes the first two letters of Gambian

parts.note: NT is the National Trust, the British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: A domineering woman speaks out against two Gambian wildlife protectors.
explanation.definitionFit: A termagant is a shrewish, bossy woman, named after an imagined deity in mystery plays.

clue.text: Sink or swim

definitions.meaning: to sink is to drop down, as prices or the sun may
a brief swim in the sea is a quick plunge

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit the short word: dropping lower, and a quick bathe in water.

clue.text: River god is lost — captivated by heartless Danae

indicators.note: captivated by says the shortened god goes inside what is left of Danae
heartless says the middle letters of Danae are removed
is lost says the word is drops out of the god's name

parts.note: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god of the dead

explanation.surface: A river god disappears, entranced by a cold-hearted Danae of Greek myth.
explanation.walkthrough: Danae, mother of Perseus, loses her three central letters under 'heartless'; the god is Egyptian, despite the river setting.
explanation.definitionFit: The Danube is a major European waterway flowing to the Black Sea.

clue.text: Repeated exercises involving end of muscle attached to right eye

indicators.note: attached to says the right letter is joined on
involving says the doubled exercises abbreviation wraps round that letter
repeated says the exercises abbreviation appears twice

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises

indicators.note: end of takes the final letter of muscle

explanation.surface: Repeated workouts strain a muscle connected to the right eye.
explanation.definitionFit: Peeper is informal slang for an eye.

clue.text: Ambassador to welcome cast

parts.note: an ambassador is addressed as His Excellency, abbreviated HE
ave is Latin for hail, a word of welcome

explanation.surface: An envoy is sent to greet a theatre company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like a noun for actors but is the verb throw, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw something with effort, as a stone or line, is to fling or toss it.

clue.text: Soldiers taken in by justification for submission

indicators.note: taken in by says the soldiers go inside the justification word

parts.note: a defence is an argument offered to justify an action
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: Troops are fooled by an excuse offered for giving in.
explanation.definitionFit: Respectful yielding to another's judgement or authority is a form of submission.

clue.text: Hit back at witness describing trouble in port

indicators.note: back says the word for hit is read in reverse

parts.note: to ram is to strike hard

indicators.note: describing in the sense of drawing a line around, so the witness word encloses trouble

parts.note: to witness something is to see it
ill as a noun is misfortune or trouble

explanation.surface: Someone strikes back at a witness giving an account of trouble in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense of tracing a line around something, not giving an account.
explanation.definitionFit: Marseille is the great French Mediterranean seaport.

clue.text: Mosey along to find doctor in drink

indicators.note: in says the doctor goes inside the drink

parts.note: ale is beer, a drink
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: Wander along to the pub and find the doctor having a pint.
explanation.definitionFit: To stroll at a leisurely pace is to mosey, an American informal verb.

clue.text: One more on Earth destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed says the letters of the words on and Earth are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A further planet wiped out, as in a science fiction disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroyed' rearranges the seven letters of ON EARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: An additional one of the same kind is one more, as in 'have a second cup'.

clue.text: Girl not entirely finding debts very funny

indicators.note: not entirely says the girl's name loses its final letter

parts.note: Hilary is a girl's name
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debts

explanation.surface: A girl not quite managing to find her debts amusing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that makes people laugh uproariously is extremely amusing.

clue.text: Seconds away from theft of duck

indicators.note: away from says the seconds letter is removed from the theft word

parts.note: steal as a noun is a theft, or a bargain

explanation.surface: Just seconds after a theft, someone ducks out of sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duck' could be a verb in the surface; here it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The teal is a small freshwater dabbling duck.

clue.text: British Airways admits sick German taking flight to Hawaii causes uproar

indicators.note: admits says the airline letters take in the shortened sick word

parts.note: BA is the airline's own abbreviation

indicators.note: taking flight says the German letter flees the word for sick

parts.note: feeling rough means feeling unwell
HA is an old abbreviation for Hawaii

explanation.surface: An airline concedes that an ill German passenger flying to Hawaii caused a scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking flight' sounds like air travel but signals the German letter leaving; 'to' just joins the Hawaii piece on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A brouhaha is a noisy commotion or fuss, an uproar.

clue.text: Bury study written up in confinement

parts.note: to inter is to bury a body

indicators.note: written up says the study word is read from bottom to top in a down light

parts.note: a den is a private study or workroom

explanation.surface: Burying a study report while in lockdown.
explanation.definitionFit: People interned are detained or confined, especially in wartime.

clue.text: Failing to escape

definitions.meaning: a failing here is a small lapse or error
to get away unnoticed, as from a captor's grasp

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a minor mistake and getting away unnoticed from a person or place.

clue.text: First rock band introduced to a member of the nobility reportedly

indicators.note: introduced to says the band goes inside the jetty word
reportedly says the noble's title is taken by its sound, giving a seaside jetty

parts.note: a peer is a member of the nobility
R.E.M. is an American rock band

explanation.surface: A top rock group is presented to an aristocrat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' turns the nobleman into a seaside structure by sound alone; 'First' is an adjective here, not an ordinal.
explanation.definitionFit: Premier as an adjective means first in rank or importance.

clue.text: Subsequently becoming essential to ignore tales from the east

indicators.note: from the east says the hidden letters are read backwards, right to left in an across light
essential to says the letters sit at the core of the following words

explanation.surface: Later on it becomes vital to ignore stories from the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Subsequently becoming essential' as the definition; 'becoming' is a link and 'essential to' signals the hidden letters NORETAL, which 'from the east' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening at a later time happens subsequently.

clue.text: Country club oddly rejected accepting earl immediately

indicators.note: accepting says the even letters take in the earl abbreviation
oddly rejected says the odd-placed letters of club are dropped, keeping the even ones

parts.note: anon is an old word for at once, immediately

explanation.surface: A country club turns away an earl, only to let him in straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: Lebanon is a Middle Eastern nation on the Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Shoe polish applied liberally at first

parts.note: to sand wood is to smooth and polish it

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letters of applied and liberally

explanation.surface: Shoe polish slapped on generously to begin with.
explanation.definitionFit: A sandal is an open shoe held on by straps.

clue.text: Shocked when Georgia served up bear once

indicators.note: served up says the Georgia letters are turned upwards in a down light

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
hast is the archaic form of have, and to have can mean to bear, as in bearing a name

explanation.surface: Horrified when Georgia dished up bear meat in the old days.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone aghast is filled with horror or amazement, utterly appalled.

clue.text: Risk disregarding duke's wrath

indicators.note: disregarding says the duke letter is left out of the risk word

parts.note: danger is a risk or hazard
D is the abbreviation for duke

explanation.surface: Taking a chance by ignoring a duke's fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrath is intense fury, the strongest form of annoyance.

clue.text: Bit of graffiti removed from stone support on certain part of castle wall

indicators.note: removed from says that opening letter is taken out of the stone word

parts.note: a gem is a precious stone

indicators.note: bit of picks only the opening letter of graffiti

parts.note: a bra is a supporting garment
sure means certain

explanation.surface: Graffiti scrubbed off a stone buttress on a stretch of castle wall.
explanation.definitionFit: An embrasure is the opening in a battlement or wall through which weapons are fired.

clue.text: Extempore offering from well-read libertarian

indicators.note: offering from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An off-the-cuff remark made by a bookish libertarian.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking extempore means without preparation, improvised on the spot.

clue.text: Dorian can change to become overly strict

indicators.note: change says the letters of Dorian can are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dorian Gray, perhaps, could turn into a harsh disciplinarian.
explanation.definitionFit: Draco's ancient Athenian laws were notoriously harsh, so excessively severe rules carry his name.

clue.text: Get to know poet by name

parts.note: Edward Lear was a poet of nonsense verse

explanation.surface: Become acquainted with a poet by his name.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to know a fact or skill is to acquire it through study or experience.

clue.text: Biblical figure edges away from wild animal

indicators.note: edges away from says the outer letters are stripped off the animal word

parts.note: a sloth is a slow-moving tree-dwelling animal of South America

explanation.surface: A figure from scripture inching away from a wild beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edges away' reads as creeping off but signals losing the ends of SLOTH.
explanation.definitionFit: Lot was Abraham's nephew, who fled Sodom while his wife became a pillar of salt.

clue.text: Starting point for design of Dutch prison garb

indicators.note: design of says the letters are arranged into a new form

explanation.surface: The inspiration behind a new Dutch prison uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design of' rearranges D with PRISON GARB.
explanation.definitionFit: A launch pad for an idea or career is a starting point, from the board divers bounce off.
